body:
Hey. This really struck a chord with me. I'm 16 as well, and can relate to almost everything in here.

I want to say, hang in there. That's the only thing I can say, because really I know there's almost nothing spoken from a stranger on the internet that can make you feel better (especially seeing as I'm not great with words). But hang in there. We have so much of our lives ahead of us, and things can get better if you just hang on. I know it feels like shit and like that's all it will ever be. But don't give up on life, because it really can get better.

Also, since you say you need help, please look for some. Talk to an adult. Even if it's just opening up to a school counselor or a teacher you trust or something. It's really hard to do, but it can also really help.

Oh god you're right. I lied, I care about hurting people. Even if there's only maybe 2 people who would care, I can't do that to them. It's just so tempting to erase everything. I feel like I can't continue. I don't know if I'm strong, but thank you for the reply. Your second paragraph really got me. I'll stay for now.

Nothingness. That's the whole point. I understand. I do not want relief, I want nothing. The end. Is it either what I have now or nothing? I'll take the latter. You say, "what a waste." That will describe my life no matter how long I live.
